content.value_statement: Cold outreach fails when teams skip reply routing, warmup, and compliance checks. This skill turns an ICP and mailbox setup into a governed outbound plan.
actual_capabilities: Maps multi-step B2B cold email sequences with timing, goals, and exit rules.
Builds reply-triage branches for positive replies, objections, referrals, not-now replies, and opt-outs.
Plans domain and mailbox warmup ramps with per-mailbox send throttles.
Flags CAN-SPAM elements and consent-first jurisdiction risks as operational guardrails.
Produces a SEND sender-integrity read without computing the final EQS.
limitations: It does not write final email copy or live subject lines.
It does not verify legal compliance or replace counsel.
It depends on accurate user inputs for list source, jurisdiction, and mailbox state.
It does not compute the full SEND EQS gate score.

use_cases.title: Launch a B2B Prospecting Sequence
use_cases.description: Create a step-by-step cold outreach plan with timing, exit rules, and reply routing before the campaign starts.

use_cases.title: Protect a New Sending Domain
use_cases.description: Set a mailbox warmup schedule and daily send throttle for a new outbound domain.

use_cases.title: Prepare Compliance Guardrails
use_cases.description: Identify CAN-SPAM requirements, opt-in jurisdiction risks, and missing consent records before sending.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Basic Sequence
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a 5-step B2B cold outbound sequence for [ICP]. Use [domain age], [mailbox count], [list source], and [jurisdictions]. Include timing, exits, warmup, and compliance guardrails.

prompt_templates.title: Design Reply Triage
prompt_templates.prompt: Design reply-triage branching for my outbound campaign. Route positive replies, objections, referrals, not-now replies, and opt-outs to the next action.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Warmup and Throttle
prompt_templates.prompt: I have [number] new mailboxes on [domain age]. Plan a weekly warmup ramp and a steady daily send cap per mailbox.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare an Audit Handoff
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare the handoff for email-quality-auditor. Include sequence map, S-dimension read, jurisdiction guardrails, open loops, and source-data labels.

output_examples.input: Two new mailboxes, United States prospects, unknown bounce history.
output: A 5-step sequence with exit-on-reply, exit-on-opt-out, and exit-on-bounce rules.
A conservative warmup ramp that starts low and labels volume as estimated.
A guardrail block for accurate sender identity, postal address, and working opt-out.

output_examples.input: We need a reply-routing plan for outbound replies.
output: Positive replies route to sales booking.
Objections route to a rebuttal branch without continuing the main sequence.
Opt-outs route to immediate suppression and a consent-registry handoff.

output_examples.input: The target list includes United States, EU, and Canada contacts.
output_examples.output: The skill flags CAN-SPAM, GDPR or PECR-style consent concerns, and CASL-style consent concerns as counsel-confirmation items.

best_practices: Start with list source, jurisdiction mix, mailbox age, current volume, and bounce signals.
Use hard exit rules for every reply, bounce, and opt-out event.
Label warmup numbers as measured, user-provided, or estimated.
anti_patterns: Do not continue the sequence after any reply or opt-out.
Do not assume CAN-SPAM covers consent-first jurisdictions.
Do not push new mailboxes to full volume before warmup.

faq.question: Does this skill send emails?
faq.answer: No. It designs the sequence, routing, warmup plan, and guardrails. Sending happens in a separate email platform.

faq.question: Can it replace legal review?
faq.answer: No. It gives operational guardrails and tells you when to confirm jurisdiction-specific rules with counsel.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code compatible skill hosts.

faq.question: What inputs should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the ICP, list source, jurisdiction mix, mailbox count, domain age, warmup state, and recent sending signals.

faq.question: Does it compute the final SEND EQS?
faq.answer: No. It reads the sender-integrity dimension and hands the program to email-quality-auditor for final scoring.

faq.question: How does it handle opt-outs?
faq.answer: It requires immediate suppression, stops all future steps, and hands the suppression fact to consent-registry.
